tasks.label: Package extension (ZIP)
tasks.command: version=$(sed -n 's/.*"version": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' manifest.json | head -n1) && mkdir -p dist && out="dist/bitrix24-browser-notifications-$version.zip" && rm -f "$out" && zip -r -X "$out" manifest.json _locales icons offscreen options popup src -x '*.DS_Store' && echo "Created $out"
